definition: Every municipality-level source identified by the 2026-08-25 research is classified as acquired, already published, or blocked by a specific reproducibility constraint. Catalog search hits alone are not counted as coverage.

acquired.scope: All Lucerne municipalities plus Zürich city
2025 national actuals plus six verified current enacted municipal budget CSVs

not_acquired.reason: No standardized national adopted-budget dataset was found; council PDFs require eleven document-specific extraction contracts.
The official portal resets automated connections and exposes no documented public bulk/API contract; urban local governments are outside the system.
The reviewed SAMI endpoint is a credentialed login and no public nationwide bulk export was located.

not_acquired.scope: Stockholm, Göteborg and Malmö enacted budgets
not_acquired.reason: The official current publications are council PDFs with presentation tables, not stable row-level datasets; national SCB actuals are already loaded separately.

not_acquired.scope: Socrata discovery beyond the four verified city adapters
not_acquired.reason: The 1,600 search hits mix states, counties, non-US portals and non-budget artifacts. Each dataset needs municipality, stage, schema and duplication review before it can be counted.
Publications are local or provincial and no national item-level adopted-budget feed was identified.
State collections and national statistics provide aggregates; adopted item-level plans remain council publications.
Councils publish plans individually and the national layer is standardized summary data rather than line items.
The Ministry of Finance defines forms, but entity files are distributed across provincial and local portals without a national entity-level bulk endpoint.
National municipal accounts are available; a central item-level adopted-budget lifecycle was not found.
The three regional systems use different models and no Belgian national item-level lifecycle exists.

not_acquired.scope: IKVS tenants and official PDF-only cities
not_acquired.reason: IKVS has municipality-specific tenants without a documented central export; Hannover, Magdeburg, Erfurt, Cottbus, Rostock and Saarbrücken publish document-specific PDFs.

The catalog mixes communes, intercommunal bodies, regions, departments, annex budgets, duplicates and PDFs. Six current municipal CSV contracts were verified and acquired; the remaining records are discovery leads, not a defensible denominator.
